hero.subtitulo: Flavors born from the produce, the care, and a warm way of understanding the table.

nosotros.label: About Us
nosotros.descripcion1: Located in San Cristóbal and part of the neighbourhood for over 15 years, El Atlante is a restaurant that has built its identity on great produce, genuine hospitality and an honest approach to cooking.
nosotros.descripcion2: Our cuisine is rooted in Canarian gastronomy, with a special focus on fish and seafood, while staying true to the traditional dishes that are part of our essence. We believe in a kitchen that respects the ingredients, honours the flavours and strives to make every visit enjoyable from start to finish.
nosotros.descripcion3: Add to that a privileged setting by the sea, and the experience becomes something more than just a meal. El Atlante is a place to share, to savour without haste and to return to — with the assurance that quality, warmth and a true sense of identity will always be here.
nosotros.pilar1Desc: Carefully selected fish and seafood, brought straight to your table.
nosotros.pilar2Desc: We respect the ingredients and honour time-honoured flavours.

carta.label: Exclusivity
carta.subtitulo: Iconic dishes that define our gastronomic identity without artifice.
carta.pulpoDesc: Our most emblematic preparation, served with local peppers and premium paprika.
carta.croquetasDesc: A burst of the sea in every bite. Extra-creamy béchamel made fresh daily.
carta.pescadoDesc: Directly sourced from the San Cristóbal boats. Traditional preparation or chef's style.
carta.polvitoDesc: The quintessential Canarian dessert. Layers of meringue, biscuit and the finest dulce de leche.

section2.title: 2. What are Cookies?
section2.p1: A cookie is a file that is downloaded to your computer when you access certain web pages. Cookies allow a web page, among other things, to store and retrieve information about the browsing habits of a user or their equipment.

section3.title: 3. Types of Cookies Used
section3.d1: These are those that allow the user to navigate through a web page and the use of the different options or services that exist in it, such as, for example, controlling traffic and data communication or making the request for registration in an event.
section3.d2: These are those that allow the user to access the service with some predefined general characteristics based on a series of criteria in the user's terminal, such as language or browser type.
